run_evaluate_dexmachina_cli: run the evaluate_dexmachina CLI to compute object tracking metrics from trajectory npz files
run_compare_spider_vs_rl: run the evaluate_dexmachina CLI with --compare flag to compare SPIDER vs RL metrics across seeds
run_evaluate_trajectory_function: run evaluate_trajectory to compute mean and std of position, rotation, and articulation distance metrics from a npz file
run_evaluate_rl_rollout_function: run evaluate_rl_rollout to compute pos, rot, and arti distances from a DexMachina RL rollout npz file
run_collect_comparison_results: run collect_comparison_results to gather SPIDER and RL metrics for each task and seed combination
